architecture_clues: AI Vector Search co-located with operational data—no separate vector store
Chatbot for both customers and internal customer-care agents
OCI Generative AI for chatbot LLM
Oracle Autonomous AI Database as unified data platform
records.business_outcome: Uniti deflected billing-related call-center load with a 24/7 chatbot, reduced manual data correlation by agents, and delivered self-service answers grounded in Uniti's authoritative billing data via AI Vector Search.
records.business_problem: Uniti's customer-care team was answering more than 10,000 monthly billing-related inquiries by manually correlating data across multiple billing, CRM, and operations systems—a high-cost, latency-prone workflow that limited 24/7 self-service for enterprise telecom customers.
evidence_quotes: The chatbot grounds every answer in Uniti's authoritative billing, CRM, and operational data.
Uniti uses Oracle Autonomous AI Database with AI Vector Search and OCI Generative AI to provide 24/7 self-service answers to more than 10,000 monthly billing-related customer inquiries.

solution_components.name: Oracle Autonomous AI Database
solution_components.role: Unified data platform consolidating billing, CRM, and operational data; hosts AI Vector Search indexes for semantic FAQ and documentation search.

solution_components.name: Oracle AI Vector Search
solution_components.role: Semantic search engine for FAQ, billing policies, and documentation; embedded in Autonomous Database; enables AI chatbot to ground answers in authoritative data.

solution_components.name: OCI Generative AI
solution_components.role: Large language model service powering chatbot conversational reasoning and natural language understanding; delivers 24/7 self-service support.

records.solution_summary: Uniti Group, a telecommunications company managing 10K+ monthly billing-related customer inquiries, consolidated billing, CRM, and operational data into Oracle Autonomous AI Database and deployed a 24/7 generative-AI chatbot powered by OCI Generative AI and Oracle AI Vector Search to deflect call-center load. The chatbot answers customer and agent queries in natural language, grounding every response in authoritative billing data via vector search indexes, reducing manual data correlation by agents and enabling self-service billing support.

records.business_outcome: NRI delivered 11+ applications on Oracle APEX with ~65% less development effort than traditional custom-code projects, accelerating internal IT and client-engagement delivery.
records.business_problem: Nomura Research Institute, a leading Japanese systems-integration and consulting firm, needed a way for its consultants and developers to build internal and customer-facing data applications quickly without long, custom-coded development cycles, while keeping data and applications close to its existing Oracle Database estate.
evidence_quotes: NRI delivered more than 11 applications on Oracle APEX, reducing development effort by approximately 65%.
Nomura Research Institute (NRI) standardized on Oracle APEX to deliver internal and client-facing applications quickly on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
metrics: ~65% reduction in development effort vs traditional development

solution_components.name: Oracle APEX
solution_components.role: Low-code rapid application development platform enabling NRI consultants to build internal and client-facing data applications 65% faster than custom development.

solution_components.name: Oracle Database
solution_components.role: Backing data store for all 11+ APEX applications; maintains consistency with NRI's existing Oracle Database estate.

solution_components.name: OCI Kubernetes Engine
solution_components.role: Container orchestration for hosting containerized APEX services and microservices.

records.solution_summary: Nomura Research Institute (NRI), a leading Japanese systems-integration and consulting firm, standardized on Oracle APEX as its rapid application development platform on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure to accelerate internal IT and client-facing application delivery. By leveraging Oracle Database and OCI Kubernetes Engine, NRI delivered 11+ applications using APEX with approximately 65% reduction in development effort compared to traditional custom-code development, enabling consultants to focus on business logic rather than infrastructure.

architecture_clues: Single Oracle Fusion Cloud suite for ERP, EPM, and HCM
records.business_outcome: Baylor replaced 17–18 systems with one Oracle cloud platform, cut new-hire onboarding from 26 steps to 6–7, reduced payroll runs per cycle from 11 to 2, and gained the financial visibility needed to scale a $37M online-education business while pursuing research-university status.
records.business_problem: Baylor University was operating 17–18 disparate finance, HR, and planning systems with manual processes—new-hire onboarding required up to 26 separate steps and payroll was run 11 times per pay cycle. The university also needed scalable systems to support a fast-growing online education business approaching $37M in revenue and a research-university growth strategy.
records.data_flow: Finance, HR, and planning data from 17–18 legacy systems flows into Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, HCM, and EPM; onboarding and payroll workflows process transformed data; integration provides single source of truth.
evidence_quotes: Baylor University replaced 17 to 18 disparate finance, HR, and planning systems with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, EPM, and HCM.
Baylor's online-education business has grown to $37 million in revenue.
New-hire onboarding now takes 6 or 7 steps instead of 26, and payroll runs were reduced from 11 to 2 per cycle.
metrics: Payroll runs per cycle reduced from 11 to 2

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP
solution_components.role: Consolidates financial data from legacy systems; manages accounts payable, receivable, and general ledger.

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Cloud EPM
solution_components.role: Provides enterprise planning and budgeting across finance and research operations.

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM
solution_components.role: Centralizes HR data, automates new-hire onboarding, manages payroll, and benefits administration for university workforce.

solution_components.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
solution_components.role: Provides cloud hosting, scalability, and infrastructure for the unified Fusion Cloud suite.

records.solution_summary: Baylor University consolidated finance, planning, and HR data from 17–18 disparate legacy systems onto a unified Oracle Fusion Cloud suite (ERP, EPM, and HCM) hosted on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. The integration redesigned hiring onboarding from 26 manual steps to 6–7 automated steps, reduced payroll cycle runs from 11 to 2, and provided the financial visibility and scalability needed to support rapid growth in online education ($37M revenue) and pursue research-university expansion.
